lines: In an effort to support the City’s Housing Element, a roadmap to addressing local housing needs, the Housing Division has recently created the Affordable Housing Funding Plan to better align the City’s housing spending with housing goals. The Affordable Housing Funding Plan (AHFP)for Fiscal Years 2025-2027 is now available for download and viewing.

The purpose of the Affordable Housing Trust Fund is to assist in the creation and preservation of affordable housing in the City of South San Francisco for the benefit of low- and moderate income households.
The types of projects eligible for consideration under the City's Affordable Housing Trust Fund are:
Conversion of market rate units to affordable housing.
Acquisition and rehabilitation of potential limited equity cooperatives.
Predevelopment loans/grants to assist nonprofit and for profit developers with project feasibility studies, site acquisition and design studies for potential affordable housing projects.
